ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Nordwand reads steps, workouts, sleep, water and mindful minutes to check off your rules automatically. Values are only read.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Nordwand does not write any data to Apple Health.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Nordwand needs camera access so you can take photos for your journal and your progress photos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nordwand needs access to your photos so you can add pictures to your journal.
